name: dsh-plugin-gate
description: Installation safety gate & data-protection guard for DeepSeek Harness: 60 static signature rules scan plugin sources for malicious install scripts, credential theft, obfuscation and network callbacks before 'dsh plugin add', with scan baselines (gate_diff), structured reports (gate_report), 12 destructive-command patterns and workspace-boundary checks.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node test/baseline.test.mjs && node test/osv.test.mjs && node test/protect.test.mjs && node test/report.test.mjs && node test/rules.test.mjs && node test/scan.test.mjs
